leaf_characteristics.shape: Imparipinnate compound with 5–9 lobed glandular-pubescent ovate leaflets
leaf_characteristics.color: Medium to dark green, pungent solanaceous aroma

stem_characteristics: Herbaceous, branched, glandular-hairy, erect or decumbent, 0.5–2.0 m
flower_characteristics: Cymes of yellow 5-lobed star-shaped flowers with reflexed petals
fruit_characteristics: Fleshy berry, globose or pyriform, ripening from green to lustrous red
growth_habit: Erect to sprawling short-lived perennial herb grown as annual, 60–180 cm
habitat_and_climate: Warm temperate to sub-tropical climate, frost-sensitive, optimal 20°C–27°C
water_requirements: Regular moderate watering; avoid wetting foliage
soil_preferences: Well-drained fertile sandy loam to clay loam rich in organic matter, pH 6.0–7.0
uses: Fresh culinary fruit/vegetable, curries, chutneys, salads
Commercial processing: purees, sauces, ketchups, lycopene extract

common_pests_and_diseases.name: Early Blight (Alternaria solani)
common_pests_and_diseases.symptoms: Concentric target-board rings on older lower leaves with yellow halo
common_pests_and_diseases.management: Foliar Mancozeb (2 g/L) or Azoxystrobin

common_pests_and_diseases.name: Late Blight (Phytophthora infestans)
common_pests_and_diseases.symptoms: Water-soaked dark lesions rapidly turning necrotic with white fungal down on leaf undersides
common_pests_and_diseases.management: Metalaxyl + Mancozeb (2.5 g/L) spray

common_pests_and_diseases.name: Tomato Leaf Curl Virus (ToLCV)
common_pests_and_diseases.symptoms: Severe upward leaf curling, puckering, vein clearing, stunted bushy growth
common_pests_and_diseases.management: Control whitefly vector with Imidacloprid (0.3 ml/L); grow ToLCV-resistant hybrids

prevention_guidance: Stake indeterminate plants with bamboo trellising
Mulch around roots with straw to prevent soil splashing
Avoid overhead irrigation

common_pests_and_diseases.name: Phomopsis Blight
common_pests_and_diseases.symptoms: Circular brown leaf spots with pycnidia; soft rot on fruits

common_pests_and_diseases.name: Little Leaf of Brinjal

common_pests_and_diseases.management: Rogue infected plants; control vector leafhopper with Dimethoate

prevention_guidance: Adopt regular clipping of infested shoots every 7 days
Intercrop with Coriander or Fennel to attract beneficial predators

leaf_characteristics.shape: Simple, ovate to elliptic lanceolate smooth leaves with acute apex

stem_characteristics: Herbaceous to semi-woody angular erect branched stem, 40–120 cm

fruit_characteristics: Pungent elongate berry with persistent green calyx, turning green to fiery red
growth_habit: Erect branching subshrub grown as annual, 40–120 cm
habitat_and_climate: Warm tropical and sub-tropical climate; 20°C–30°C optimal for fruit set

common_pests_and_diseases.management: Whitefly vector management with Diafenthiuron 50 WP (1 g/L); yellow sticky traps (15/acre)

common_pests_and_diseases.name: Anthracnose / Die-back (Colletotrichum capsici)
common_pests_and_diseases.symptoms: Necrotic black spots on mature fruits with concentric rings; terminal twigs dry from top down
common_pests_and_diseases.management: Spray Azoxystrobin (1 ml/L) or Copper Oxychloride (2.5 g/L)

common_pests_and_diseases.name: Thrips and Mites Complex

common_pests_and_diseases.management: Fipronil 5 SC (1.5 ml/L) or Spiromesifen 22.9 SC (1 ml/L)

prevention_guidance: Install yellow and blue sticky traps (20 each/ha)
Practice border cropping with maize or sorghum to impede vector entry

common_pests_and_diseases.name: Fruit Borer (Earias vittella)

flower_characteristics: Fragrant yellowish-white bisexual flowers in spreading drooping panicles

prevention_guidance: Pinch main shoot at 1 m height to stimulate multiple bushy fruiting laterals
Harvest pods before seeds become hard

common_pests_and_diseases.name: Black Rot (Xanthomonas campestris pv. campestris)

prevention_guidance: Use mustard as trap crop (sow 2 rows of mustard for every 25 rows of cabbage)
Harvest firm heads before bursting occurs

Harvest compact heads before curds loosen (riciness)
